subtype: Approach: saying no and walking to a trusted adult [Action]
passage: Come closer, little one; your grandfather Tenzin wants to tell you what your cousin Trisha did when she was ten. A man near the school gate told her to come with him to see something. Trisha said, "No." She stepped back, kept a scooter's length away, and walked over to the security guard near the entrance. She told the guard exactly what the man had said, and the guard stood beside her until the man had gone. That evening she told her parents too, and we all sat and listened until she had finished. I was proud, but even more than that, I was relieved.

qa.q: Who did Trisha tell at the gate?
qa.a: Trisha told the guard at the gate.

qa.q: What was Tenzin feeling when he heard about that evening?
qa.a: He felt proud and even more relieved that Trisha was safe.

qa.q: What choices did Trisha make that kept her safe?
qa.a: She said no, kept her distance and walked to the guard, then told her parents, so adults knew straight away.

qa.q: How might the guard have seen Trisha coming toward him?
qa.a: The guard probably saw a child asking for protection, and stood beside her until the man had gone.

grounding: A girl refuses to go anywhere with a stranger, keeps distance, tells the gate guard, then her parents.

subtype: Approach: saying no and walking to a trusted adult [Action]
passage: It was pouring when Amandeep's evening tuition ended, and her friend Kashish had already been picked up. Amandeep waited under the building's shelter for her father, who was late because of the flooded road. A woman she didn't know came over with an umbrella. "Come, beta, I'll drop you home. Your papa asked me." Amandeep's heart thumped. She stepped back, keeping the pillar between them. "No, thank you." "It's raining so hard..." "No." She walked, fast, to the guard's cabin at the gate. "Uncle, that lady asked me to go with her. I don't know her." The guard stood up, stayed with her, and called her father. At home, she told her mother everything, and her parents called the tuition teacher that night.

qa.q: How did Amandeep feel when the woman offered to drop her home?
qa.a: She felt frightened, her heart thumping, but she was firm and did not go.

qa.q: Which steps helped Amandeep, and what could the family add?
qa.a: She said no, kept her distance and went to the guard; a family code word would help her check anyone who says a parent sent them.

qa.q: How does the evening look to the guard?
qa.a: The guard takes it seriously, staying with Amandeep and calling her father right away.

grounding: It shows a girl refusing to go with an unknown person, keeping her distance, going to the guard and telling her parents at home.

subtype: Approach: saying no and walking to a trusted adult [Action]
passage: Outside the Pune apartment complex, Yamini was waiting for the school van when a man in sunglasses stopped his scooter. "Your mummy sent me. Get on, I'll take you." Yamini stepped back until she was against the gate. "No." "She said it's urgent." "No." She turned, walked quickly through the gate and went straight to the security cabin. "Vijay bhaiya, a man on a scooter asked me to go with him. I don't know him." Vijay came out, but the scooter had gone. He noted the time in his register, stayed with her until the van came, and phoned her mother. That evening her mother sat with Yamini, told her she had done exactly right, and informed the building committee.

qa.q: How did Yamini feel when the man said it was urgent?
qa.a: She was probably scared, but determined, repeating "No" and not moving toward him.

qa.q: What else could Yamini's family do to make her even safer?
qa.a: They could agree a code word, so she can test anyone who says her mother sent them.

qa.q: How does the incident look to Yamini's mother?
qa.a: Her mother is probably shaken but proud, telling Yamini she did exactly right and alerting the building committee.

grounding: It shows a girl refusing to go with a stranger, keeping her distance, going to the guard at the gate and her parents learning the same day.
